Actors Samay Raina and Medha Shankar's Relationship Rumors Intensify

Social media is abuzz with speculation regarding a relationship between actors Samay Raina and Medha Shankar. A viral Reddit post claims the two secretly married in Bandra in September. However, this claim has not been independently verified, and neither Raina nor Shankar has issued an official statement. The rumors gained traction following their public appearances together.
